summary: A card that fades in while rising 16px into place, replaying on a loop only while it is in view.
use: Entrance of a card, a toast, a list row or any block that appears after the page has loaded.
spec: `MotionStage` from `@codeatlasdev/ui` with `label="Fade rise: a card fades in while rising into place"` and `loop={2400}`
`{#key m.cycle}` remounts the card so `animation: fade-rise` runs again each cycle
Keyframes: `from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }` to `to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }`
Under reduced motion `class:rise--run={!m.reduced}` drops the animation and the card renders in its final state
